name: rapp-static-workiq
description: Synthetic Microsoft-Graph-flavored work-insights API (people analytics / collaboration insights) for Project Phoenix at Meridian Manufacturing Group, a fictional global manufacturer mid-S/4HANA-transformation. Fully synthetic, no real data.

entries.name: people
entries.description: Person profiles with workstream, skills, site, utilization, open actions and average response time.

entries.name: expertise
entries.description: Topic -> ranked experts with evidence counts (answers given, docs authored, meetings led).

entries.name: collaboration
entries.description: Per-workstream weekly message/question volumes, answered vs unanswered, median response hours, top askers/answerers.

entries.name: topics-trending
entries.description: Weekly top-8 trending topics with mention deltas, rank movement and top voices.

disclaimer: 100% synthetic. Every person, workstream, site, metric and topic below is invented for demo purposes. No real people, no real company, no real telemetry, no real Microsoft Graph data.
